purpose: Define presets as reusable explicit parameter/configuration sets for Lens and Studio tools without making presets semantic authority.

topics.name: Presets
topics.purpose: Define presets as reusable explicit parameter/configuration sets for Lens and Studio tools without making presets semantic authority.

semantics.parameter_rule: Only declared configurable parameters may be stored/applied.
semantics.semantic_rule: Preset changes projection/tool configuration, not source semantics.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Preset compatibility is validated against target schema/version.
semantics.sharing_rule: Presets may be exported as configuration data.

invariants.rule: Studio surfaces compose or project existing canonical semantics and do not become parallel authorities.

references.purpose: Lens configurations may be saved as presets.
